operational.description: Shared projects, issues and Wiki-backed use cases. Wiki is installed automatically.

demo.name: Planning
demo.description: Explore synthetic projects and issue trees without saving changes.

presentation.outcome: Turn shared goals into projects and issues your team can finish.
steps: Write goals, user stories, a draft press release and demo acceptance material.
Create stones, pebbles and sand with independent parent/sub-issue relationships.
Assign issues, track completion and keep shared documents current.
presentation.access: Organization members share projects and issues. Forerunner priorities and personal source evidence remain private. Demo data is synthetic and read-only.
